name: io.github.hughhan1/database
description: Give each Holon app a private PostgreSQL store with atomic SQL batches and retry keys.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The Postgres cluster's host, the only one the app may reach.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_USER
environmentVariables.description: The admin role's login name, such as postgres.<branch id> on PlanetScale.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The admin role's password. Each store's password derives from it.

title: Database for Holon
